stories.title: NDP caucus to take oath in Victoria while Eby to be sworn in separately
stories.summary: New Democrats will be sworn into office in the British Columbia legislature Thursday but former premier David Eby won't be among them.

stories.title: Weather station records 469 millimetres of rain in latest B.C. soaking
stories.summary: Environment Canada says 469 millimetres of rain fell at a weather station west of Vancouver Island in just over two days as B.C. continues to get drenched by wet weather.

stories.title: Shooting at the auto shop: how Canada is tackling India’s extortion gangs
stories.summary: Documents obtained by Global News give a rare inside look at an investigation into an extortion scheme.

stories.title: B.C. child-killer granted temporary release over Christmas — his victim’s favourite holiday
stories.summary: Shane Ertmoed was convicted in 2002 of the sexual assault and killing of 10-year-old Heather Thomas, who went missing from her father’s townhouse complex Cloverdale in 2000.

stories.title: Ukrainians in Canada wait for permanent residency as calls grow for more pathways
stories.summary: The Ukrainian-Canadian Congress in B.C. is urging Ottawa to create additional pathways for permanent residency for those who don't have Canadian family connections.

stories.title: B.C. premier pledges to bolster health-care staffing as woman dies outside closed ER
stories.summary: Lorne Doerkson said his new government will keep ERs and maternity wards open in smaller B.C. communities through flexible staffing and a $50-million rural health emergency fund.

stories.title: Girl’s family frustrated with ICBC, access to care, after she was hit by car
stories.summary: Makenna suffered a severe brain injury in May after a car hit her and a boy while they were on an e-scooter crossing the street at Hastings and Hythe Avenue in Burnaby.

stories.title: B.C. education changes: Restore letter grades, repeal SOGI, bring back O’Canada
stories.summary: Lynne Block was elected in 2026 as the MLA for North Vancouver-Seymour and has been appointed as the Minister of Education and Child Care.

stories.title: NHLers on staying patient in a rebuild
stories.summary: Ryan Strome and the Anaheim Ducks were on an upswing.

stories.title: Parts of B.C. Coast under orange-level rainfall warnings as final, potent storm hits
stories.summary: British Columbia's coast is getting another weather wallop as Environment Canada warns of rain of up to 225 millimetres along much of the coast before the end of the day.
